column1: # LONG rows for tools/ops/call_profile_job.sh (lane fx-profile-big-rows, 2026-11-20): pass as
# CP_ROWS_FILE=tools/ops/call_profile_rows_big.tsv with CP_PASSES=pyspy,nsys,shim CP_REPORT_TOP=15. The rows of the
# four kernels that hold 89% of board time and had no profile (ideas-rank-shared-RESULT.md section 3 item 1): the
# x_decomp dense kit (lle, min-cov-det, als), the Isomap graph stage, the DBSCAN pair-distance pass, the online-linear
# minibatch loop (pa-clf), and the next rows of its list (autoarima, permutation-test-score, gbdt-ordered,
# select-mutual-info-reg, ridge-cv). Each is profiled in ONE call per pass (ms >= 10,000: no warmup, the window around
# the first scored call), each pass under its cap (2 x the stored seconds + 300 s; `cap=` overrides).
# ms = the stored board time of the row's fit (`new_ms`, L40S, build 7f5eac7eab: ~/mojolearn-evidence/measure-candidate/
# build-7f5eac7eab/{full1p1r,full1p2r/x,full2p1/x,part2.part2/x}/compare-tg-nvidia.json). Race ids are the full board's
# (tools/paper_compare.py plan_all); `tools/ops/targeted_rows.py plan` resolved every one on 2026-11-20.
# Biggest first: a job cap kill loses the smallest rows.
